name: Kyonyuu Musume o Suimin'yaku de Nemurasete
original_name: 巨乳娘を睡眠薬で眠らせて
source:
A girl of some vague family relation came to visit.

She's very obedient when my mother is watching. 
But, when it's just us, she's an insufferable brat. 

"Damn it! I'll get back at you somehow, you little--!" 

I remembered that my doctor had prescribed sleeping pills from before. 

"Perfect...... This will put her lights out......" 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154315.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个有着某种模糊家族关系的女孩来拜访。

当我妈妈在旁边的时候，她很听话。
但是，当只有我们的时候，她就是一个令人难以忍受的孩子。

“该死！我会想办法报复你的，你这个小——！” 

我记得医生之前给我开了安眠药。

“完美……这样就能熄灭她的灯了……” 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154315.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
